status: Combat and hybrid-skill runtime implemented with production ability content, hotbar input, target lock and animation/VFX binding; AI activation and packaged validation remain in progress

hierarchy.replication: The parent ActionComponent replicates one compact committed-action state containing ability ID, data definition, target, server start time and monotonic sequence.
hierarchy.children: RPGAction Blueprint children and combat ability data definitions are not individually replicated. The parent initializes legacy action ownership and forwards their state/stopped delegates.
hierarchy.progression: RPGPlayerState.Skills owns owner-only learned ranks and hotbar assignments. It calls the possessed character's ActionComp for server execution.
hierarchy.model: Abilities from melee, spell, utility and passive paths can be combined when level, point and prerequisite rules are met; there is no exclusive class lock.
hierarchy.catalogue: DT_PlayerAbilities (FRPGAbilityCatalogueRow) is the authoritative 32-skill catalogue on BP_PlayerState.Skills; inline AvailableAbilities remains the fallback.

implemented: Server-validated learning and upgrading with spell-point costs and prerequisite IDs
Server activation routed through the parent ActionComponent
Target validity, faction, range and line-of-sight validation
Mana and stamina costs, cooldown enforcement, damage scaling, armor/penetration and critical hits
Replicated character death state and presentation event
Defeated quest credit continues through the spawn context health/death bridge
All 32 widget skill-tree abilities have executable DA_Player_* definitions with branch prerequisites (Fire/Ice/Electric/Earth/Water/Light/Shadow/Air/Melee/Passive)
Payload executions: damage, projectile, area, cone, heal, shield, blink, root, fear, drain, wall, chain and melee window (RPGSkillExecution + authoritative ARPGProjectile)
Montage release events bound via Event.Animation.SpellRelease with combat animation mappings on BP_PlayerCharacter's DT_AnimationRouter
Hotbar activation across all 12 slots (LMB, RMB, 1-9, 0) via ARPGPlayerController::InputKey, with panel/paused gating
Skill-menu equip mode reassigns the selected skill to any slot via the same 12 keys or HUD globe buttons, with swap/displace semantics

Target lock toggle (Tab, editable TargetLockKey): locks the best front-facing hostile in range and line of sight, steers the camera while held, and drops on death/range/occlusion; free-aim resolves via camera trace when unlocked
Passive tree (HaloOfProtection armor, LifeSiphon, ManaSiphon) applies through GAS effects on learn
Starter loadout: Slash(LMB), FireBolt(RMB), ElectricBolt(1), FullSwing(2), IceShards(3)
remaining: Implement AI selection and activation through the same ActionComponent
Bind per-skill distinct montages/VFX where unique assets exist (shared cast/melee montages are the current default)
Balance pass on rank scaling, costs and cooldowns in the generated definitions
Run listen-server/remote-client action replication checks and packaged validation
